value.rationale: A lower bound of order x/log x in a specific admissible congruence class is a natural local distribution refinement of the hyperbolic square-free almost-prime problem. It preserves the seven-prime-factor cutoff in a fixed progression and has a clear use for congruence-sensitive counting. It does not overclaim a bound for distinct norms.
